statement: You receive two integers a and b. Swap them without any third variable by using XOR three times: a becomes a XOR b, then b becomes a XOR b, then a becomes a XOR b again. Print the two values after the swap, separated by a space. Convince yourself at each line which original value each name holds.
constraints: Both integers arrive on one line, separated by a space.

example.why: After the three XOR lines the names have exchanged their original values.

hint: Write the three lines symbolically: the second line computes a XOR b XOR b, and the pairs cancel.
mistake: Applying the trick to one single storage slot aliased twice - the first XOR zeroes it and both values are lost.
